storage.name: out_valid_q
storage.purpose: tracks whether output register holds a valid beat

storage.name: out_data_q
storage.purpose: holds accepted input data until downstream handshake

storage.name: grant_q
storage.purpose: one-hot source tag for current output beat

storage.name: arb_ptr_q
storage.purpose: next round-robin scan start pointer, legal values 0..2

datapath.buffering: single output register, no deep FIFO

fsm_list.name: output_state
transitions: EMPTY -> FULL when a selected input handshakes into the output register
FULL -> FULL when downstream handshakes and a new input is accepted in the same cycle
FULL -> EMPTY when downstream handshakes and no new input is accepted
FULL -> FULL when downstream is not ready

control.scheduler: round-robin scan over input indexes starting from arb_ptr_q or the post-handshake next pointer

performance_constraints: Input accept to output valid latency is 1 cycle.
Sustained throughput is 1 beat per cycle after fill when out_ready_i is high.
Under three continuously valid inputs, service interval per input is 3 output handshakes.
low_power_constraints: Hold output registers stable under backpressure.
Do not toggle output valid/data when idle and no input is selected.
ordering_and_hazards: Do not advance arb_ptr_q on input accept alone; use output handshake.
When output handshakes and new input is accepted in the same cycle, scan from the post-handshake pointer to avoid reselecting the just-served input.
Ignore grant_o when out_valid_o is low.
verification_sensitive_points: No double input accept in one cycle.
Pointer does not advance while output is stalled.
